research_engine.plan_queries.description: Search queries per language and round.

research_engine.analyze_gaps.description: Gaps and new contradictions after a round.

transcripts.extract_claims.description: Claims and insights from a transcript chunk.

claims.verify.description: Verify claim clusters against established facts.

story.design.description: Acts, purpose and opening of the story.

documentary.pronunciation.description: Readings a voice might get wrong.

documentary.pronunciation.ar.description: Readings an Arabic voice might get wrong.

documentary.pronunciation.arbiter.description: Decides whether the voice or the pronunciation key is wrong for a word that stayed wrong.

documentary.critic.description: Critic of the production script (focus per critic).

host_angle.description: Decides the angle of one host appearance before it is written: the one concrete moment it reacts to (quoted from the narration), what it does to the host, how the host talks about it and the question for the viewer.

host_writer_fa_ar.description: Host dialogue in Persian and Arabic.

host_meaning_checker.description: Facts the host's spoken words add, change or sharpen.

language.draft.description: Stage 1: the one shared English draft of a case (90 minutes), from the plan and all the evidence.

english.evidence_audit.description: One-pass audit of the English draft against the supplied facts and source excerpts only; a report, it changes nothing.

language.rewrite.fa.description: Persian film version (60-70 minutes) re-told natively from the English master.

language.inspect.fa.description: Listening-quality review of the Persian film version.

language.final.fa.description: Final Persian film text from the last version and the critique.

language.rewrite.de.description: German film version (60-70 minutes) re-told natively from the English master.

language.inspect.de.description: Listening-quality review of the German film version.

language.final.de.description: Final German film text from the last version and the critique.

language.rewrite.ar.description: Arabic film version (60-70 minutes) re-told natively from the English master.

language.inspect.ar.description: Listening-quality review of the Arabic film version.

language.final.ar.description: Final Arabic film text from the last version and the critique.

language.rewrite.en.description: English film version (60-70 minutes) re-told from the approved master.

language.rewrite.es.description: Mexican Spanish film version (60-70 minutes) re-told natively from the English master.

language.inspect.es.description: Listening-quality review of the Mexican Spanish film version.

language.final.es.description: Final Mexican Spanish film text from the last version and the critique.

language.rewrite.it.description: Italian film version (60-70 minutes) re-told natively from the English master.

language.inspect.it.description: Listening-quality review of the Italian film version.

language.final.it.description: Final Italian film text from the last version and the critique.

language.rewrite.fr.description: French film version (60-70 minutes) re-told natively from the English master.

language.inspect.fr.description: Listening-quality review of the French film version.

language.final.fr.description: Final French film text from the last version and the critique.

language.rewrite.pt.description: Brazilian Portuguese film version (60-70 minutes) re-told natively from the English master.

language.inspect.pt.description: Listening-quality review of the Brazilian Portuguese film version.

language.final.pt.description: Final Brazilian Portuguese film text from the last version and the critique.

language.rewrite.tr.description: Turkish film version (60-70 minutes) re-told natively from the English master.

language.inspect.tr.description: Listening-quality review of the Turkish film version.

language.final.tr.description: Final Turkish film text from the last version and the critique.

language.inspect.en.description: Listening-quality review of the English film version.

language.final.en.description: Final English film text from the last version and the critique.

language.glossary.description: Standard spelling of the evidence's people and places in one language (owner approves).

language.length_correction.description: One-time bounded length correction: expands only the acts that are too short, from the English master's material for the same act.

language.length_correction.fa_ar.description: The same bounded length correction for the Persian and Arabic texts, written by their own final-writer role.

language.fidelity.description: Checks that a translated film text keeps the meaning of the approved English text: events, relationships, values, attributions and certainty.

english.audit_fix.description: Checks each factual finding of the evidence audit against the evidence and gives the smallest edit for the confirmed ones.

mvp.needs.description: Main Visual Planner step 4: graph-aware visual needs per beat.

mvp.crime_scenes.description: Names the crime scene(s) of a case from the evidence: a street address when the evidence has one, else the town.

mvp.verify.description: Main Visual Planner step 8: one picture judged against the entities the film needs.

mvp.verify_second.description: Independent second verifier for an uncertain exact-identity judgement.

mvp.queries.description: Main Visual Planner step 6: the next bounded search round for one unmet requirement.

mvp.direct.description: Main Visual Planner step 8: which approved item fills which shot slot of a beat.

mvp.segment.description: Main Visual Planner step 6: cut a source video by meaning, from sparse frames.

mvp.moment_pick.description: Moment cutting: from the descriptions of the case's video pieces, which parts may show what is said at each bare moment.

mvp.moment_cut.description: Moment cutting: from the frames of candidate footage, the exact windows that show what is said at one moment.

mvp.moment_check.description: Moment cutting: an independent check of a finished cut against the words it will run under.

mvp.timing.description: Story timing: what each approved picture or clip shows and the first beat in which the story has told of it.

mvp.describe.description: Just before the film is planned: what each approved picture or clip shows and which of the case's people it shows (vision).

mvp.person_inspector.description: Before the film is planned: for each person the text names for the first time, which approved photos of them give nothing away there.

documentary.name_forms.description: Before the film is directed in a language with its own script: how the narration writes each person and place of the case (full, first and last name).

documentary.voice_prepare.edit.description: Before a prepared language (Persian) is voiced: each sentence's final text and the pronunciation rules of its risky words.

documentary.voice_prepare.check.description: Before a prepared language is voiced: whether each beat's final text is faithful to the English source (meaning, names, numbers, facts).

mvp.overlay_scan.description: Picture and footage check: where other people's logos, watermarks and caption strips are laid over a picture or clip.

mvp.topic_match.description: Topical fill: how related each approved picture or video is to what is said at a bare moment.

detective.director.description: Detective Director (Section C): investigation memory and scene direction (map_film/direct_scenes/repair modes).

detective.design_director.description: Alternative Visual Design Director (Section G): design/review/repair of one dispatched detective visual, from real rendered previews.

detective.film_reviewer.description: Film Experience Reviewer (Section J): checks achieved audience understanding, continuity, curiosity, routes findings to their repair owner (plan_audit/rendered_review/repair_check modes).

mvp.clip_edges.description: Clip edges: which frames at the start or end of a clip or video are an intro or an end card (a logo screen, a QR code, credits, a presenter with a caption) and not footage.

detective.text_analyser.description: Text analyser: splits the narration into parts and says which card kinds suit each part.

detective.card_maker.description: Card maker: one card of one kind from one part of the text, or none when the text does not support it.

detective.card_inspector.description: Card inspector: checks one card against the text it came from and reports logical problems for the toolkit to fix.

documentary.semantic_review.audio.description: After a Persian narration block is voiced (and after its avatar video is made): listens to the audio and judges meaning, dates, numbers, names, pronunciation and delivery against the source text.

documentary.reading.glossary.description: Reads a stretch of the Persian narration with the English text and returns the film's name table (people with their parts and titles, places, foreign words, doubts), so that every name is read the same everywhere.

documentary.reading.write.description: Writes the reading text of one block: for every numbered word its Latin reading (vowels, ezafe, pause), decided by the meaning of the word in its sentence.

documentary.reading.check.description: Adversarial check (another model) of the reading text of one block: rejects a word with proof, or doubts.

documentary.reading.check_blind.description: The independent check of the reading text of one block (blind mode): another model reads the block itself, with the editor's instructions and without the editor's answer; code compares the two readings word by word and sends every difference to the arbiter.

documentary.reading.arbitrate.description: Decides one word the editor and the checker read differently, or sends it to the owner as a doubt.

documentary.reading.choose.description: Listens to the clip of one word of the Persian narration and chooses which of several written readings it was said as.

documentary.reading.tashkeel.write.description: Writes the reading text of one block of an Arabic narration: every word with the vowel marks (tashkeel) it is said with in its sentence, names and ambiguous words marked, confidence per word.

documentary.reading.tashkeel.check.description: Vowelises the unsure words of an Arabic block independently, without seeing the editor's answer; code compares the two word by word.

documentary.reading.tashkeel.arbitrate.description: Decides between two different vowelisations of one Arabic word in its sentence (a, b, neither with the right one, or unsure).

documentary.irab.write.description: Vowelizes one block of the Persian narration word by word (irab, and the spoken form where marks are not enough) from the English source and the meaning of each word.

documentary.irab.check.description: The same task by another model that does not see the first answer: the two are compared word by word.

documentary.irab.arbitrate.description: Chooses between two vowelizations of a word by the meaning and the grammar of its sentence.

pronunciation.linguist.description: Writes the reference irab of a sentence (formal and colloquial Iranian Persian, ezafe, compound verbs, names from memory only).

pronunciation.risk.description: Decides which words of a sentence need a pronunciation intervention before synthesis, from memory, recorded failures and the sentence.

pronunciation.intervention.description: Chooses the least invasive effective way to make the voice say a word as the reference says it (exact-form dictionary rules first).

pronunciation.audio_observer.description: Establishes from a recording what was said about chosen words; evidence kinds are kept apart from inference.

pronunciation.prosody.description: Judges the naturalness of a take independently of pronunciation: flow, rhythm, pauses, emotion, stress, identity, artifacts.

pronunciation.memory.description: Turns a person's corrections and intervention outcomes into durable pronunciation memory without overwriting a human approval.

pronunciation.qa.description: Independently challenges the conclusions of the other pronunciation agents against the evidence.
